We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.</p> <p><strong>Team Lead - Quality Assurance, Support Excellence</strong></p> <p>Quality Assurance is a vital leadership function within Customer Support, defining the operational standards for accurate, empathetic, and compliant merchant interactions. As our global footprint expands, Customer Support QA drives consistent quality across teams while establishing the strategy, vision, and operational frameworks necessary to elevate agent performance and merchant trust. Strategic AI integration is key to this transformation, moving QA from reactive audits to a continuous, AI-first model that scales across all support interactions.</p> <p>As the QA Team Lead for Customer Support, you will be part of our global Support Excellence organization, architect and execute an AI-first QA migration strategy from scratch, building evaluation models that directly improve core support metrics like CSAT, NPS, FCR, and TTR. This strategic leadership role directly manages a dedicated team of 2 QA Program Managers in Chicago, setting quality vision, defining success metrics, and embedding core evaluation dimensions, such as response accuracy, tone, empathy, issue resolution, and documentation into daily Support Operations.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define, own, and execute the global Customer Support QA strategy and vision, leading the end-to-end migrat

Set clear vision, manage resource planning, and foster a high-performance, ownership-driven culture.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Collaborate across Group Finance (Financial Controlling, Lead to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Payroll, and Tax) and with non-finance stakeholders (Procurement, Legal, Infrastructure, and HR).</li> <li>Cross-functional Alignment: Work closely with global leads, operational teams, and the broader finance organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Process:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive stream-level automation initiatives across the R2R pipeline to streamline month-end closing, eliminate manual tasks, and ensure complete data accuracy.</li> <li>General Ledger Management: Manage GL activities related to operational and capital expenditures (for example, OPEX, CAPEX, Intercompany and leases), as well as revenue and accounts-receivable related accounting (Lead-to-Cash).</li> <li>Take an active role in systems and product design, leading the foundational work on data quality to execute complete "touchless tax returns".</li> <li>Audit Support: Work together with Financial Controlling; provide support and information to internal and external auditors regarding GL and Tax Accounting data.</li> <li>Financial Analysis: Prepare variance analysis during the month-end closing process.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have at least 6 years of work experience in financial accounting, tax compliance, and reporting within a multinational organization, including leadership experience.</li> <li>In-depth expertise across the different areas of financial accounting and reporting and a systems thinking approach to scaling to contribute to Adyen’s Group Finance team.</li> <li>Strong people leadership skills to build and lead high-performance teams in an international setup; it is expected that you will coach and develop others in the t

This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!</span></p> <p><strong>What’s next?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days.
